sources.query: SELECT ACCDET_ID, BANK_ID, BANK_ACCT_NUM, ACCDET_NAME, BANK_NAME, BANK_NUMBER, BANK_ALT_NAME, BANK_ALT_NUM, BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, BANK_ACCT_ALT_NUM, BANK_BRANCH_NAME, BANK_BRANCH_CODE, BANK_HIER_NAME, BANK_HIER_CODE, BANK_CAT_NAME, BANK_CAT_CODE, BANK_TYPE_NAME, BANK_TYPE_CODE, BANK_USER_NAME, CONTACT_NAME, TAX_NUMBER, PHONE_NUM, SWIFT_NAME, SWIFT_CODE, COUNTRY_CODE, COUNTRY_NAME, STREET_ADDRESS1, CITY, STATE_NAME, COUNTY, AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, PRIMARY_FLAG, ACTIVE_FLG, END_DATE, X_CUSTOM, TENANT_ID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, INTEGRATION_ID FROM POC.W_BANK_DS

SELECT BA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS ACCDET_ID, BB.BANK_BRANCH_ID AS BANK_ID, BA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS BANK_ACCT_NUM, BA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS ACCDET_NAME, BB.BANK_NAME AS BANK_NAME, BB.BANK_NUMBER AS BANK_NUMBER, BB.ALTERNATE_BANK_NAME AS BANK_ALT_NAME, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS BANK_ALT_NUM, BA.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, BA.ALTERNATE_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS BANK_ACCT_ALT_NUM, BB.BANK_BRANCH_NAME AS BANK_BRANCH_NAME, BB.BANK_BRANCH_NUMBER AS BANK_BRANCH_CODE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS BANK_HIER_NAME, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS BANK_HIER_CODE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS BANK_CAT_NAME, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS BANK_CAT_CODE, BA.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE AS BANK_TYPE_NAME, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS BANK_TYPE_CODE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS BANK_USER_NAME, HP.PARTY_NAME AS CONTACT_NAME, HP.JGZZ_FISCAL_CODE AS TAX_NUMBER, HP.PRIMARY_PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE_NUM, BB.EFT_SWIFT_CODE AS SWIFT_NAME, BB.EFT_SWIFT_CODE AS SWIFT_CODE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS COUNTRY_CODE, BB.COUNTRY AS COUNTRY_NAME, BB.ADDRESS_LINE1 AS STREET_ADDRESS1, BB.CITY AS CITY, BB.STATE AS STATE_NAME, BB.COUNTY AS COUNTY, BA.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE AS AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS PRIMARY_FLAG, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS ACTIVE_FLG, BA.INACTIVE_DATE AS END_DATE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS X_CUSTOM, 'DEFAULT' AS TENANT_ID, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS INTEGRATION_ID FROM POC.CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS BA JOIN POC.CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES BB ON BA.BANK_BRANCH_ID = BB.BANK_BRANCH_ID LEFT JOIN POC.HZ_PARTIES HP ON BB.BANK_BRANCH_ID = HP.PARTY_ID

JOIN: CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_BRANCH_ID = CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.BANK_BRANCH_ID is a genuine explicit FK (same column name/values on both tables). CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.BANK_BRANCH_ID = HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID is NOT a real FK -- neither bank table exposes a party/bank-owner id column in this schema. This join is a row-position assumption based on this container's known synthetic-data pattern (every table's sample rows are seeded 1..10 with matching row-for-row placeholder text, per the GTAS/PurchaseRequisitionLinesFact precedent's finding that 'every ID-shaped column across every table in this container follows a PLACEHOLDER_N or row-number pattern unrelated to real join semantics') -- not a confirmed business relationship. Flagged, not silently assumed correct.

ignoreColumn columns fall into two groups: (a) genuinely absent from this container's schema -- BANK_HIER_NAME/CODE, BANK_CAT_NAME/CODE, BANK_TYPE_CODE, BANK_USER_NAME, BANK_ALT_NUM, BANK_ACCT_ALT_NUM (name-vs-number mismatch against ALTERNATE_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME), COUNTRY_CODE (only a country *name*-shaped field exists), PRIMARY_FLAG, ACTIVE_FLG (no matching Y/N flag column found on either bank table), SWIFT_NAME (mapped the same EFT_SWIFT_CODE value as SWIFT_CODE -- redundant, so only SWIFT_CODE is compared), END_DATE (BA.INACTIVE_DATE is a plausible but unconfirmed semantic match), BANK_ID (no clean bank-institution id distinct from BANK_BRANCH_ID); and (b) parameter/formula-driven regardless of schema -- TENANT_ID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, INTEGRATION_ID, X_CUSTOM. BANK_TYPE_NAME is mapped (BA.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE) but should be treated as low-confidence.

EXPECTED OUTCOME: this container's actual/target table (W_BANK_DS) contains independently-seeded synthetic placeholder text (e.g. ACCDET_NAME='ACCDET_NAME_1') that does not derive from the source tables' own independently-seeded placeholder text (e.g. CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME='BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_1') -- confirmed via get_data_source_table_sample_data on both sides before this dataflow was ever run. A Failed run here should be expected and is not evidence of a test case defect on its own -- analysis-agent should cross-check against this note before recommending any fix.
